name: elabftw-rdm
description: Research-data-management plugin for elabFTW. Three composable skills: elabftw-mcp (generic agent operating manual for the elabFTW data model + MCP tool surface + gap→workaround catalogue), elabftw-schema-init (interactive workshop that designs a lab's schema with the researchers, presenting decisions as visual HTML sheets), and labschema (the per-lab structural contract elabftw-schema-init generates). Grounded in FAIR, ALCOA+, the DCC lifecycle, ISA, and W3C PROV.
